hero.uptimeTip: Measured by this console session since it first reached the server. The server does not expose an uptime endpoint.

models.title: Loaded models
models.unloadBody: "{{id}}" will be released from memory. Its buffer is freed immediately; the file stays on disk.
models.emptyBody: Scan a folder for GGUF files and load a model to start generating.

genSpeed.title: Generation speed
genSpeed.tip: Latest generation speed (tok/s) across loaded models.

paging.title: Paging demand
paging.tip: OS page faults per generated token from the last generation. Lower means the model stays warmer in RAM/page cache.

residency.title: Page-cache residency
residency.tip: Share of the model file resident in the OS page cache (Windows only).

issues.title: Open issues
issues.tip: Reports currently in the open state.

activity.title: Activity
activity.tip: The five most recent generations from the server's usage history. Every value is real per-run telemetry; tok/s shows – when a streaming path had no measurement.
activity.emptyTitle: Recording starts after your next generation
activity.emptyBody: The server keeps the last 500 generations, but this history only began with the phase-4 backend — older runs are not listed.

tiering.title: Auto-tiering
tiering.tip: Real routing telemetry from /v1/tiering/stats — which tier handled requests and why. Never fabricated.
tiering.disabled: Auto-tiering is off — enable it in Settings to route requests between a fast and a quality model.
tiering.emptyBody: Send a chat with the ⚡ Auto model selected and routing statistics will appear here.
